en: A multi‑view black‑and‑white postcard composed of five photographs. The images show: a riverside town with industrial buildings in a valley; a large stepped‑gabled town hall on an open square with people and early automobiles; the ornate twin‑tower west front of a Gothic cathedral; a view along a river with a bridge, boats, and a tower in the foreground; and a panoramic scene of the same river crossed by a long bridge leading toward a hilltop cathedral complex and old town. The layout and style suggest an early‑20th‑century European city postcard.
